items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like replacement of the internal frost-fractured valve: 1 × €52.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover the connection hose renewed with the valve: 1 × €27.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover the fitting repair labour at all three billed hours: 3 × €98.
Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 expressly cover consumables actually used on the fitting repair, but not a generic shop-supplies surcharge. Estimate 1 × €18 if the line represents materials used.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.11 allow one attendance for the covered repair. Estimate 1 × €76 at the full attendance rate, with no stated reduction.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging equipment used to locate the escape, and section 3.6 exempts it from the tools exclusion. Estimate 1 × €65, below the €2,500 gross event cap.
Section 7.1.11 bars a separate charge for a return visit unless agreed in advance, and no approval is stated. The conditional estimate is 1 × €76.

items.description: Removal of loose and spalled plaster
items.rationale: The facade frost endorsement is in force, and sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(a) cover removing failed plaster on the damaged elevation. Estimate 2 × €95.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover like-for-like base plaster on the frost-damaged area. Estimate 1 × €140.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover re-forming the damaged substrate, provided this is distinct from the base plaster charge. Estimate 1 × €180.
Section 2.6.2 covers priming the reinstated area of the damaged elevation. Estimate 1 × €65.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(c) cover drying when needed before reinstatement of the frost-damaged area. Estimate 1 × €110 if the drying was necessary.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(d) cover the coats required by the like-for-like finish on the damaged elevation, not the separately billed rear repaint. Estimate 1 × €260 for the four-coat line.
Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.7(f) cover labour on the damaged elevation; the undamaged rear repaint is separately billed. Estimate 5 × €70.

Sections 2.6.2 and 7.1.8 cover the scaffold in full because it served only the damaged elevation and was removed before the rear repaint. Estimate one two-storey installation, about 48 m² at €18/m², or €864 gross.
Sections 2.6.3(a), 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting a separate undamaged elevation, even for appearance matching. The conditional estimate is €750 for the single lump sum.
Sections 2.6.2 and 5.2.2 cover disposal of plaster removed from the insured frost-damaged elevation. Estimate €75 for the single charge covering a few rubble sacks.
Sections 3.6(b) and 7.1.12 exclude separate administration charges even when the repair is covered. The conditional estimate is 1 × €25.
Sections 3.6(a) and 7.1.12 exclude catering for the contractor's personnel. The conditional estimate is 3 × €15.
